transcript: Speaker A: Main tumhe challenge de raha hoon. 14 din, roz 15 minute expert ke video dekho. AI coach ke saath practice karo. May khatam hone se pehle tum English bolna shuru kar doge. Ek rupaye ki himmat hai tumme? English seekhna mushkil nahi hai, mushkil hai shuru karna. To aaj shuru karo. English Seekho app download karo. Do hafte ka challenge lo. Pehla hafta experts ke video dekho. Spoken English show hai, Hindi mein samjha ke English bolna seekhate hain. Chote do-paanch minute ke video. Doosra hafta AI coach ke saath practice karo. 24 ghante available hai. Jo expert ke video mein seekha, wo AI coach se bol ke practice karo. Galat bologe wo sudhaar degi. Pronunciation galat hai, pakad legi. Tense galat lagaya, bata degi. Kabhi hasegi nahi, kabhi judge nahi karegi. Aur sabse badi baat, kisi stranger se baat nahi karni. Tum aur AI coach, bas. Private, safe, tumhari speed se. 14 din mein English perfect nahi hogi, par tum bina ruke, bina dare bol paoge. Trial sirf ek rupaya. No bahana, sirf practice. English Seekho app download karo aaj hi. [I am challenging you. For 14 days, watch expert videos for 15 minutes daily and practice with an AI coach. You will start speaking English before May ends. Do you have the courage of 1 rupee? Starting is the hard part, so start today by downloading the English Seekho app. The first week, watch short Hindi-to-English videos. The second week, practice speaking with the AI coach who corrects your pronunciation and grammar 24/7 without judgment. It is private, safe, and at your own pace. In 14 days, you will speak without fear. Trial is just 1 rupee. Download the app today.] Speaker B: To install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. Disclaimer: English Seekho kisi bhi government authority, institution, brand, organisation ya individual ke dwara endorsed, sponsored, affiliated ya associated nahi hai. Outcomes individual effort aur doosre factors par depend karte hain.
summary: An AI-generated child presenter challenges viewers to a 14-day English-learning challenge using the English Seekho app. He explains that the course combines short expert video lessons with private, judgment-free AI speaking practice to build confidence. The ad promotes a 1-rupee trial and directs users to install the app.
